caption:
In Costa Rica's highlands, mountain roads often follow the natural fall line rather than contouring the slopes. This means mountain biking in Costa Rica will eventually introduce you to grades that defy gears. When the slope rises past twenty percent on wet grass, the fastest way forward is a steady, rhythmic walk. There is no defeat in stepping off the saddle here; it is simply a change of pace, an opportunity to lift your eyes from the front wheel and notice how the cloud forest crowds the ridge. The air is thin, cool, and damp, and the only sound is your own breathing. Where has the trail asked you to step off?
